<?php
trait Trait163Review {
    public static function stop(?self $value = null): never {
        echo 'body:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';';
    }
    public const array Y = [self::stop(...)];
    public static array $x = self::Y;
}
trait Layer163Review { use Trait163Review; }
set_error_handler(static function () { return true; });
class First163Review {
    use Layer163Review;
    public static array $x = self::Y;
}
$old = First163Review::Y[0];
$old = clone $old;
class Later163Review {
    use Layer163Review;
    public static array $x = self::Y;
}
$later = Later163Review::Y[0];
try { $old(); } catch (TypeError $e) {
    echo 'old:', $e->getMessage(), ':', $e->getLine(), ';';
}
try { $later(); } catch (TypeError $e) {
    echo 'later:', $e->getMessage(), ':', $e->getLine(), ';';
}

<?php
trait Trait163AuthorA {
    public const CALL = self::take(...);
    public static $seed = self::CALL;
    public static function take(self $value): string {
        echo 'body:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';';
        return 'ok';
    }
}
class Owner163AuthorA {
    use Trait163AuthorA;
    public static $seed = self::CALL;
}
$capture = Owner163AuthorA::CALL;
try { $capture(); } catch (ArgumentCountError $e) {
    echo 'missing:', $e->getMessage(), ':', $e->getLine(), ';';
}
try { echo 'captured:', $capture(new Owner163AuthorA), ';'; }
catch (TypeError $e) { echo 'captured-type:', $e->getMessage(), ':', $e->getLine(), ';'; }
try { echo 'direct:', Owner163AuthorA::take(new Owner163AuthorA), ';'; }
catch (TypeError $e) { echo 'direct-type:', $e->getMessage(), ':', $e->getLine(), ';'; }

<?php
trait Trait163AuthorB {
    public const BAD = self::bad(...);
    public const END = self::end(...);
    public static $badSeed = self::BAD;
    public static $endSeed = self::END;
    public static function bad(?self $value = null): int {
        echo 'bad-body:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';';
        return [];
    }
    public static function end(?self $value = null): never {
        echo 'end-body:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';';
    }
}
class Owner163AuthorB {
    use Trait163AuthorB;
    public static $badSeed = self::BAD;
    public static $endSeed = self::END;
}
$bad = Owner163AuthorB::BAD;
$end = Owner163AuthorB::END;
try { $bad(); } catch (TypeError $e) {
    echo 'return:', $e->getMessage(), ':', $e->getLine(), ';';
}
try { $end(); } catch (TypeError $e) {
    echo 'never:', $e->getMessage(), ':', $e->getLine(), ';';
}
